findings.evidence: PBS will not collect personally identifiable information from you, other than what you supply to us on a voluntary basis upon request.
For example, we may collect your IP address, browser information and reference site domain, as well as related information such as the date on which you visit the Site.

We use non-personally identifiable information, such as IP addresses or demographic information (zip codes for example) to tailor our Site to the interests/locations of our users and to measure traffic within our Site.
